g.title: DENV_QSP
g.text: Dengue and Dengue Shock Syndrome — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
one antibody response, two channels of opposite sign · the fever break and the plasma leak are the same event seen twice
antibody-dependent enhancement E(titre) = (1−N)·[1+(Φ−1)·A/(A+K)] · Starling J = Kf·[(Pc−Pi) − σ(Πp−Πi)] · the leak stops only when the circulation fails
